failure_summary.description: Agents omitted required cache saves or retrieved a cached result without applying and saving the newly requested filter.
Agents inferred unsupported preferences or mapped vague wording to a narrower hotel amenity.
A state abbreviation was passed as a city instead of using the state field.
The agent retrieved and printed unrelated, already-completed flight results while handling a hotel follow-up.

patch.reasoning: These behaviors violate existing explicit rules: save every result-producing call, apply new same-domain constraints to suitable cached results, map states to the state field, avoid inferring preferences, and do not touch unrelated completed results. Since the skill already covers these patterns, adding overlapping instructions would duplicate content rather than patch a gap.
